rows.note: Use 嚇親 as the everyday all-purpose verb when something suddenly frightens or alarms someone.

example.english: That loud bang did alarm me.
example.traditional: 頭先嗰聲巨響嚇親我喇。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 go2 seng1 geoi6 hoeng2 haak3 can1 ngo5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a physical device that detects danger and gives a warning, such as a fire alarm.

example.english: The alarm went off at home, so get out quickly!
example.traditional: 屋企個警報器響咗，快啲出去！
example.jyutping: uk1 kei2 go3 ging2 bou3 hei3 hoeng2 zo2 faai3 di1 ceot1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an alarm clock that wakes someone up.

example.english: My alarm clock didn't go off this morning, so I was late.
example.traditional: 我個鬧鐘今朝冇響，搞到我遲到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 naau6 zung1 gam1 ziu1 mou5 hoeng2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ci4 dou3

rows.note: Use this for the fear or anxiety caused by a perceived danger, especially when it spreads among people.

example.english: After the news spread, the public was briefly gripped by alarm.
example.traditional: 消息傳開後，市民一度陷入恐慌。
example.jyutping: siu1 sik1 cyun4 hoi1 hau6 si5 man4 jat1 dou6 haam6 jap6 hung2 fong1

rows.note: Use 提醒 when alarming someone means alerting them to danger or reminding them to take necessary action.

example.english: You should alarm them about the slippery floor.
example.traditional: 你要提醒佢哋地下好跣。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 tai4 sing2 keoi5 dei6 dei6 haa6 hou2 sin2

rows.jyutping: ling6 A tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3
rows.note: Use this construction when the emphasis is on causing someone to become vigilant rather than simply frightening them.

example.english: This scam can alarm me into becoming more vigilant.
example.traditional: 呢單騙案令我提高警覺。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 pin3 on3 ling6 ngo5 tai4 gou1 ging2 gok3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a warning signal or warning notice about danger, rather than the device producing it.

example.english: The television broadcast a typhoon alarm, so everyone went home right away.
example.traditional: 電視播出颱風警報，大家即刻返屋企。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 bo3 ceot1 toi4 fung1 ging2 bou3 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 faan1 uk1 kei2
